Service mapping The plan review identifies the exact contracting entity before confirmation. A change of contracting entity, custody model, governing law, or insolvency treatment is material and creates a new terms version. It cannot be applied silently to an existing locked position.

title: Customer Relationship and Asset Rights
description: The legal state of a digital asset changes strictly through an explicit, user-confirmed product lifecycle event.
text: Customer Relationship and Asset Rights Before a plan opens Prior to activating an earning plan, credited funds remain in standard custodial holding managed by our registered operator, Pulpo Fintech, S.A. de C.V. (PSAD 0023), in coordination with institutional custody provided by Coinbase Custody Trust Company, LLC. Legal title, account segregation, and full withdrawal execution rights remain directly with the user. When an earning position opens When a user activates a Flexible or Locked Earning Plan (30, 90, 180, 365 days), the assets enter a regulated managed liquidity framework. Legal Status: The arrangement operates as a contractually defined yield position under the primary Client Agreement executed with Pulpo Fintech. Asset Utilization: Assets are pooled into approved yield strategies subject to strict risk parameters (maximum 80% LTV, no uncollateralized lending). Marketing Transparency: No platform page uses generic terms like "your assets never leave your wallet" if the underlying plan creates a contractual creditor claim. Product consent object Every activated plan generates an immutable digital proof record containing: Product version and active legal terms hash. Contracting entity: Pulpo Fintech, S.A. de C.V. (PSAD 0023). Asset identifier, principal amount, and APY rate locking. Maturity date, exit liquidity window, and timestamped user confirmation. Insolvency and loss Whale CeFi earning positions are digital asset strategies and are not protected by traditional government bank deposit insurance. Fiduciary Isolation: Asset reserves managed through Coinbase Custody are structurally segregated and held on a fiduciary basis. Loss Mitigation: In the event of market anomaly or third party protocol default, loss allocation is governed under the designated Whale Dedicated Yield Reserve and the formal insolvency resolution policies of Pulpo Fintech, ensuring client claims are prioritized in accordance with El Salvador digital asset laws (Ley de Emisión de Activos Digitales).

title: Eligibility and Geographic Access
description: Availability is determined by the intersection of customer type, country, entity, product classification, asset, network, sanctions policy, verification state, and operational capability.
text: Eligibility and Geographic Access The website, onboarding, application, API, documentation, and Client Agreement read from the same versioned eligibility matrix. If the matrix denies a capability, the interface does not merely display a disclaimer; it blocks the operation. Eligibility states Available, limited, professional only, institutional only, temporarily suspended, unsupported, and legally prohibited are distinct. A service can be available in one country through one entity and unavailable elsewhere. WENI can explain the published rule and gather information. It cannot make the final eligibility decision or override a deterministic deny result.

title: Risk Disclosure
text: Risk Disclosure You can lose some or all of your principal and any expected reward. Whale CeFi earning products are not bank deposits and are not covered by deposit insurance unless an exact verified policy explicitly states otherwise. Material risk classes platform insolvency and creditor recovery; counterparty, custodian, borrower, or strategy default; stablecoin depeg, issuer freeze, or redemption restriction; concentration, correlation, leverage, liquidation, and slashing; rehypothecation and encumbrance; liquidity queues, delayed exits, and suspended routes; smart contract exploit, admin compromise, and oracle failure; blockchain congestion, reorganisation, bridge, validator, and finality risk; account takeover, fraud, operational error, and reconciliation failure; legal, sanctions, tax, and geographic access change; conflicts of interest and related party exposure; WENI error, stale evidence, or misunderstood output. Each risk record names the owner, indicator, limit, trigger, control, residual risk, customer impact, legal loss allocation, recovery priority, review date, and jurisdiction specific wording. Controls reduce probability or impact. They do not make loss impossible.

title: Privacy and Data Protection
description: Whale CeFi separates account, verification, financial, blockchain, security, progression, support, analytics, and WENI data by purpose and authority.
text: Privacy and Data Protection The Privacy Notice identifies controller, processing purpose, legal basis, categories, recipients, subprocessors, processing regions, retention, security measures, automated decision involvement, user rights, contact route, and effective version. WENI specific boundary Private account context is retrieved only for an authorised purpose and minimum scope. Screenshots and voice inputs use an isolated ephemeral processing path unless the user expressly saves an item. Secrets and seed phrases are blocked from memory. Financial authority records are not editable through conversational memory. Rights The data rights route supports access, correction, deletion where legally available, restriction, objection, portability, consent withdrawal, and complaint. Identity verification is proportional to the sensitivity of the request.

title: Complaints and Appeals
description: A complaint is different from general support, a security incident, a fraud report, an account-restriction appeal, or a privacy request. Each route has a distinct owner and response clock.
text: Complaints and Appeals Complaint record The user receives a case ID, acknowledgement, issue summary, requested remedy, evidence channel, accountable entity, target response time, escalation status, final response, and external escalation route where applicable. The complaint reviewer can correct service decisions within authority but cannot rewrite blockchain history, invent reserve evidence, suppress an incident, or mark an audit finding closed without the required proof. Appeals Progression, eligibility, fraud, and account restrictions use their own review rules. A final outcome explains the applied rule and effective remedy to the extent permitted by security, privacy, and law.

title: Contact Routes
description: Use the route that matches the issue. Do not rely on unsolicited direct messages, Telegram administrators, or addresses on a non-canonical domain.
text: Contact Routes Use the route that matches the issue. Do not rely on unsolicited direct messages, Telegram administrators, or addresses on a non canonical domain. Situation Official route Expected result Account compromise Authenticated emergency support or account compromise form Freeze and recovery workflow with urgent case ID Security vulnerability support@whale cefi.com and the disclosure form Triage, safe harbour policy, encrypted evidence route Fraud or scam Dedicated fraud report Evidence intake and case tracking Formal complaint Complaints form and published postal/email route Acknowledgement, final response, escalation Privacy request Privacy contact Identity verified rights workflow General support Help Centre ticket Searchable guidance and case ID Whale CeFi never asks for a seed phrase, private key, remote desktop access, or transfer to a “safe wallet.” The repository includes an RFC 9116 compatible security.txt.

title: Document and Terms Control
description: Every material document has an identifier, version, effective time, owner, approval scope, hash, superseded version, and change summary.
text: Document and Terms Control Material changes include contracting entity, product classification, asset rights, custody model, rate nature, calculation method, fees, early exit, maturity, supported network, risk allocation, privacy purpose, WENI authority, and dispute route. Locked positions retain the accepted product and terms version unless a lawfully permitted emergency or user approved migration expressly applies. Flexible plan changes affect only accrual beginning at the disclosed effective time after the disclosed effective time. Documentation corrections that do not change legal or economic meaning remain traceable but do not create a new product version.
